alternative.claim: Under P!=NP, the sizes h with at least h^d single-support stage-k failures have upper asymptotic density one. Existence of polynomially bounded residual sizes meeting every polynomial window for some fixed k implies P=NP.
alternative.scope: Conditional hard-window and exact equivalent sparse-size criterion; size density not selector density.
alternative.derivation: Use arbitrary unbounded source B_K failures in simultaneous transfer, select quadratic windows and compare their lengths to endpoints; contradict sparse threshold with d=b+1.
